description.value: City Avenue Market is a family-owned grocery chain that has anchored Vancouver's Commercial Drive since 2005, emphasising fresh, local, and organic produce alongside a broad conventional grocery selection. In March 2025 the Vancouver Eastside location completed a renovation that added a full-service deli counter offering freshly sliced meats, cheeses, and prepared items. One of four Greater Vancouver locations, it also offers online ordering with delivery or pickup across the region.
